4: Infauna: polychaetes and named buried bivalves
5: Epifauna: oysters, mussels, clams, cockles, periwinkle, scallops, whelks and other shellfish
6: Crustacea: named crabs, lobster and shrimps
7: Squid & Octopus: named squid, octopus and cuttlefish
8: Flatfishes: named flatfish excluding dedicated turbot
17: Large Dem. fish: named demersal fish, including pollack, tusk, rockfish, gurnards, rockling and hooknose; no quantitative size cutoff
19: Small pelagics: Norway pout, sprat, anchovy, Argentina sp., pearlside and sandeels
20: Large Pelagics: mackerel, horse mackerel and blue whiting
21: Sharks & rays: named demersal/pelagic sharks and skates
